newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CHH, Telecom star as NZ shares end 1.2 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: CHH, Telecom star as NZ shares end 1.2 pct higher.

text.p: * NZ shares end on highs, volume good for a Monday
* Carter Holt, Telecom, Fletcher Building boost index
Fletcher Building, up 15 cents to NZ$4.54, was the other main contributor to the higher index.
Geoff Brown at Ord Minnett Securities said the market's start-of-year strength may reflect some reallocations by international investors in favour of New Zealand shares.

Meat company Affco was steady at 62 cents on unusually high volume of 2.47 million shares. Brown said a broader base of brokers appeared to be taking an interest in the stock after promotional efforts by the company last year, and domestic institutions were also looking on it more favourably.
Elsewhere, Air New Zealand "B" shares climbed 12 cents to $4.00, while the "A" shares firmed a cent to $2.73.
